_note: The 5 official test targets. ra/dec in degrees at 'epoch' (Julian year). pmra = mu_alpha*cos(dec), pmdec, both mas/yr. kind = motion (astrometry) or brightness (photometry). download.py centres the cutouts on the position moved to 2026.0. Parallax lives in targets_extra.json.
